_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 40, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses directly.
translations.2: In the first month, on the first day of it, erect the tabernacle of the tent of the assembly.
translations.3: And place therein the ark of the testimony, and screen over it with the curtain.
translations.4: Then bring in the table, and arrange its two rows; and bring in the lampstand, and light its lamps.
translations.5: Then place the altar of gold for incense before the ark of the testimony, and hang the screen of the entrance of the tent of the tabernacle.
translations.6: Then place the altar of offerings before the tent of the assembly.
translations.7: Then place the basin between the tent of the assembly and the altar, and put water in it.
translations.8: Then pitch the courtyard enclosure all around, and hang the screen of its gate.
translations.9: Then take from the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and consecrate it, and all its vessels — and it shall become holy.
translations.10: And anoint the altar of the offering and all its vessels, and consecrate it — and it shall become of the choicest of the holy things.
translations.11: And anoint the basin and its base, and consecrate the two of them.
translations.12: And bring forward Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of the assembly, and wash them with water.
translations.13: And clothe Aaron in the garments of holiness, and anoint him and consecrate him, that he may lead for Me.
translations.14: And bring forward his sons, and clothe them in tunics.
translations.15: And anoint them as you anointed their father, that they may lead for Me; and that anointing of theirs shall be for them a priesthood forever, unto their generations.
translations.16: And Moses did according to all that God had commanded him therein.
translations.17: Then, when it was in the first month of the second year, on the first day of it, the tabernacle was erected.
translations.18: The first thing Moses did in erecting it: he set down its bases, and fitted upon them its planks, and placed in it its bars, and stood up its pillars.
translations.19: Then he spread the tent over it, and placed the covering over it from above — as God had commanded him.
translations.20: Then he took the testimony and placed it in the ark, and set the carrying-poles upon it, and placed the cover over it from above.
translations.21: Then he brought it into the tabernacle, and hung the screening curtain, and screened over it — as God had commanded him.
translations.22: Then he placed the table in the tent of the assembly, on the northern side of the tabernacle, outside the curtain.
translations.23: And he arranged upon it two rows of bread before God — as He had commanded him.
translations.24: Then he placed the lampstand in the tent of the assembly, opposite the table, on the southern side of the tabernacle.
translations.25: And he lit the lamps before God — as He had commanded him.
translations.26: Then he placed the golden altar in the tent of the assembly, before the curtain.
translations.27: And he burned incense upon it from the incense of resins — as God had commanded him.
translations.28: Then he hung the screen of the entrance upon the tabernacle.
translations.29: And he placed the altar at the entrance of the tent of the assembly, and offered upon it the offering and the gift — as God had commanded him.
translations.30: Then he placed the basin between the tent of the assembly and the altar, and put in it water for washing.
translations.31: And from it Moses and Aaron and his sons would wash their hands and their feet —
translations.32: upon their entering the tent of the assembly, and upon their approaching the altar, they would wash — as God had commanded Moses.
translations.33: Then he pitched the courtyard enclosure around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung the screen of its gate; and Moses completed all the work.
translations.34: Then the cloud covered the tent of the assembly, and the light of God filled the tabernacle.
translations.35: And Moses was not able to enter the tent of the assembly, because the cloud had settled upon it and the light of God filled the tabernacle.
translations.36: And whenever the cloud rose up from the tabernacle, the sons of Israel would journey through all their journeyings.
translations.37: And if it did not rise, they would not journey — only on the day it rose.
translations.38: For a cloud from God was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire would be in it by night, before the sons of Israel throughout all their journeyings.
